machine_start_gcode:
; ============================================================
; FRANK PRO - KLIPPER START G-CODE
; Ender-3 S1 Pro + Taurus dual 5015
; ============================================================

G90
M82
M106 S0

; HOME INICIAL
G28
G1 Z10 F3000
G1 X5 Y5 F5000

; AQUECIMENTO
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
PREAQUECE_BICO S=170 ; macro do macros.cfg: so pre-aquece se o bico estiver abaixo de 170
; ESPERA CHEGAR NO ALVO (NAO ESPERA ESTABILIZAR COMO O M190/M109); O MAXIMO SO SEGURA SE VIER MAIS QUENTE DE OUTRO MATERIAL
TEMPERATURE_WAIT SENSOR=heater_bed MINIMUM=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] MAXIMUM={bed_temperature_initial_layer_single + 3}
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
TEMPERATURE_WAIT SENSOR=extruder MINIMUM=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] MAXIMUM={nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder] + 8}

; PURGE ANTES DO HOME FINAL
G92 E0
M83
G1 E6 F180
G1 E-1.5 F2100
M82
G92 E0

; HOME FINAL COM A MÁQUINA QUENTE
G28

; CARREGA A MESH SALVA NO KLIPPER
BED_MESH_PROFILE LOAD=default

; LINHAS DE PURGA
G1 Z10 F3000
G1 X5 Y20 F5000
G1 Z0.20 F300

M83
G1 E1.5 F1200
M82
G92 E0

G1 X5 Y200 E7 F1200
G1 X5.8 Y200 F5000
G1 X5.8 Y20 E14 F1200

G92 E0
G1 Z2.0 F3000

; INFORMA O TOTAL DE CAMADAS AO KLIPPER
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]
name: Frank Pro 0.4 nozzle Speed
